name: Εθνικό μονοπάτι O31
description_md:
The national waymarked hiking route O31 is located in GR. This path covers a distance of 109.1 km and is signposted as O31.

The route involves 4562 m of ascent and 4517 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent, requiring about 39 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes Metroon within 700 m, the Statue of Zeus at Olympia within 800 m, and the Olympia East Baths within 900 m.
